item.title: MC streets will pay tribute to veterans
item.description: Submitted artwork A local citizens committee has plans to honor Morgan City's veterans with signs on city streets. Morgan City could soon have a way to honor military veterans.

item.title: Morgan City Council raises auditorium rental fees
item.description: The Review/Bill Decker Fees for renting Morgan City Municipal Auditorium facilities are going up for customers beginning late next year. People who use Morgan City Municipal Auditorium can expect to pay more, but not until late next year.

item.title: CARLVEN C. COLEMAN
item.description: Carlven C. Coleman, a native of Franklin, Louisiana, and a resident of Morgan City, was born March 25, 1945, and died Dec. 15, 2025, at the age of 80.

item.title: GARY BARTLEY SR.
item.description: Gary Bartley Sr., a native of Morgan City, Louisiana and resident of Franklin, died Tuesday, Dec. 16., 2025, at the age of 68. He was born on Nov. 2, 1957.

item.title: MYRTLE B. McNEMAR
item.description: Myrtle B. McNemar, a native and longtime resident of Morgan City, Louisiana, died Dec. 19, 2025, at the age of 86.

item.title: MAXINE THERIOT BARBIER
item.description: Maxine Theriot Barbier passed away at the beautiful age of 95 on December 18, 2025. She was a lifelong resident of Golden Farms in Berwick until she moved to Maison Jardin.

item.title: MARSHALL GLENN MENDOZA SR.
item.description: Marshall Glenn Mendoza Sr., 82, passed away peacefully, Thursday, December 18, 2025, at Leonard Chabert Medical Center, surrounded by his loving family.

item.title: ERNEST AARON GASPARD
item.description: Ernest Aaron Gaspard, a native and lifelong resident of Morgan City, Louisiana, died Tuesday, Dec. 23, 2025, at the age of 77.

item.title: Bonfires on the lake
item.description: A portion of the pre-ignition lineup. From left: Christine Flores, Felix Flores, Jean Luc Flores and Kristi Flores wait for the fires to be lighted. Joshua Bertrand serves gumbo at the Louisiana Steak Jerky food truck. A houseboat floats near a wooden creature doomed to go up in flames. Flames leap into the night air. Cajun Sass cheerleaders perform. After only a few years, Christmas at the Lake Cajun Style has become an event drawing hundreds to Lake End Park.
